mapping_basis: Actual HTTP UTC or original screenshot write UTC minus original video creation UTC; ffprobe bounds; small raw samples confirm clock alignment. No game or screen operations.
limitations: Recommendations identify source material, not a narration edit or final EDL.
A paused game window is identified as paused footage; no claim of moving battle action where only a paused panel is present.
Short native event choices can be below one second; never extend across another event merely to fill narration.
No full-frame unobstructed claim: take03 exposes desktop outside the game and some take02 battles have an old war-result modal over the map.

Take04 EOF7722.700; all recommended gameplay ranges end before first exit attempt. Desktop/menu after gameplay is excluded. Final holds are continuous original paused footage, not still-image pushes or loops.
